subject: Determine whether utility_scripts/scripts/ or 03_thesis_modelling/ is canonical
description: Both trees hold near-identical srq1_benchmark*.py, srq1_figures.py, srq1_profiling.py, srq2_synthesis.py, srq4_experiment.py, forecast_service.py. Per repo-tier-structure.md, utility_scripts/ is tooling-only and must not hold pipeline logic, so the copies there are likely P0028 leftovers. Confirm via git history and imports which tree is live.
